def: to fill up further, i.e. furnish fully

occurrences.text: For the administration of this service not only supplieth the want of the saints, but is abundant also by many thanksgivings unto God;

And when I was present with you, and wanted, I was chargeable to no man: for that which was lacking to me the brethren which came from Macedonia supplied: and in all things I have kept myself from being burdensome unto you, and so will I keep myself.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
